title: Charging a Micro Market for a Settlement Period It Stood Shut
content:
The settlement raised for a period an Unattended Micro Market Program market stood shut is the standing charge for each month of the closure, together with the management fee printed against the market format for those same months at the fee share, and the held-over planogram step.

The three amounts are each rounded to the nearest cent, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent as they are taken and are then added, and the sum is rounded the same way; none of them acts on any of the others.

No product settlement is raised for a period the market stood shut, since nothing was rung at the kiosk.

## The quantities

The closure is charged as a single month. The standing charge for a month is the standby charge printed against the market format. The fee share is the standing fee share of 100 per cent. No planogram step is added.

## A closed period worked through

*Hypothetical inputs.* The market format prints a standby charge of 940.00 USD each month and a management fee of 980.00 USD each month.

The closure is charged as a single month, so the standing charge is 940.00 USD. The management fee for that same month, taken at the fee share of 100 per cent, is 980.00 USD. Nothing is added for held-over planogram work. The three amounts added and rounded give a settlement of 1920.00 USD.

*Hypothetical inputs, second case.* On a market format printing a standby charge of 240.00 USD and a management fee of nothing, the settlement raised for the closed period is 240.00 USD.
